name: Solenne Atelier SynthForm Gala Formal Set
description: A commissioned formal set — structured jacket in smoke-grey brocade with variable-length sleeves that telescope via hidden snap-track to fit limbs up to 1.8x human standard, paired with high-waisted formal trousers in matching fabric with an adaptive waistband. The jacket's back panel is architecturally cut to accommodate torso geometries that deviate significantly from human baseline. Silk-analog pocket square and coordinating cufflinks are included. This is what synthetic personhood looks like with a budget.
functionality: Telescoping snap-track sleeves, adaptive waistband, architectural back panel for non-human torso geometry.
what_it_says: I am not approximating humanity — I am exceeding it.
story_hooks: This suit was made for a synthetic's personhood hearing — the synthetic won, and now the suit is famous.
A corponation exec wants to buy it off the synthetic's chassis mid-event; the price offered is offensive.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking haute couture formal set that projects sophisticated adaptability. The jacket commands presence with its structured silhouette and architectural precision, while the high-waisted trousers create elongated lines. Despite its bespoke nature, there's an almost sculptural quality — it dresses the wearer as much as it accommodates them. Reads as luxury corporate or high-tier synthetic society.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored with intentional architectural accommodation. Jacket is fitted through the shoulders with strategic seaming along the back panel to account for non-standard torso geometry. Sleeve length adjusts via hidden mechanism. Trousers sit high on the waist with subtle ergonomic shaping. Compression elements in key zones provide subtle support without restriction.
physical_description.primary_material: Smoke-grey brocade throughout — a engineered synth-silk blend with subtle smart-weave properties. The fabric has micro-tension capability, allowing the adaptive waistband and sleeve system to function seamlessly. Naturally resistant to wear and staining.
physical_description.texture: Luxuriously smooth with subtle raised jacquard patterning across the brocade. The weave catches light at different angles, creating depth. Where mechanism sits, fabric transitions to slightly stiffer reinforced panels. Cufflinks and pocket square are matte gunmetal with silk-analog finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Smoke grey throughout with near-black undertones in shadow areas. The brocade's woven pattern creates subtle tonal variation. Cufflinks and pocket square in brushed gunmetal grey with faint iridescent accent.
physical_description.closures: Jacket: magnetic snap-track system hidden within the sleeve channels, allowing seamless telescoping. Main jacket closure via concealed magnetic buttons down the front. Trousers: integrated adaptive waistband using shape-memory polymer with discrete friction-fit anchor points. Cufflinks secure via pressure-fit magnetic system.
distinctive_features: Telescoping sleeves with snap-track mechanism — can extend to 1.8x human-standard limb length
Architecturally modified back panel with additional seaming to accommodate non-baseline torso geometry
Shape-memory adaptive waistband that molds to wearer's configuration
Hidden reinforced panels throughout for wear longevity
Solenne Atelier maker's mark embossed subtly on interior collar
Included silk-analog pocket square and coordinating matte gunmetal cufflinks
Smart-weave brocade with micro-tension capability in key zones
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — bespoke commission from exclusive atelier. Price point Φ18,000+. Accessible only to wealthy corporates or high-ranking synthetics with personal wealth.
physical_description.cultural_context: The garment explicitly dresses synthetic personhood with cultural authority. Wearing this signals: high social standing, access to bespoke augmentation services, and enough confidence in one's place to demand clothing that celebrates rather than conceals non-standard geometry. Also signals corporate elite status or synthetic leadership position. Absolutely not street-tier.
physical_description.condition_typical: When worn: pristine and meticulously maintained. The material resists visible wear, though a well-worn example might show subtle compression marks at the waistband or faint creasing along the sleeve-track channels from repeated telescoping. Accessories always polished.
